jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Java Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
We are hiring a Senior Java Engineer for our backend platform.

Spring Boot and PostgreSQL are required. Kubernetes (k8s) is a plus.

Fluent English is required; Slovak is a plus.

5+ years of experience expected.
